info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Fitness Memberships Status-v1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to retrieve the current status of fitness memberships. It serves as a vital tool for gym management systems and fitness centers, providing insights into member activity and engagement. Typical consumers include gym administrators and analytics teams who need to assess membership trends and status updates. By accessing this endpoint, organizations can efficiently monitor and manage their fitness membership programs, enhancing member satisfaction and operational effectiveness.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to check the current status of their memberships. It provides information on whether the membership is active, expired, or pending.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of memberships. This body must adhere to the defined schema to ensure proper processing and response generation.

ListFitnessMembershipsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for getting the status of memberships operations. It is expected to be a string value.

ListFitnessMembershipsStatusResponse_201.title: Membership Status Response

audit.description: Details regarding the auditing of the operation.
